defects.description: The heading "Escalation Reasons" should use the required Russian term "Причина эскалации" (or its plural form) according to the glossary.
The heading "Escalation Resolution Paths" contains the term "Resolution" which must be rendered as the required Russian equivalent "Резолюция".
Code token `EscalationRecord` was altered to `ЭскалацияRecord`; code identifiers must be byte‑identical to the source.
